# shoal_group (Resource)

A group of users. Bind roles to groups rather than individuals. Leave `members` unset when membership comes from SCIM or the OIDC groups claim, so Terraform does not fight the identity provider. Maps to `/v1/groups/{id}`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Membership managed by Terraform.
resource "shoal_group" "payments_devs" {
  display_name = "payments-devs"
  members      = [shoal_user.ada.id]
}

# Membership comes from SCIM or the OIDC groups claim: leave members unset.
resource "shoal_group" "platform_admins" {
  display_name = "platform-admins"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) Group name (matched against OIDC group claims and SCIM `displayName`).

### Optional

- `members` (Set of String) User ids. When set, Terraform owns the full membership list.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Group id, used as `subject_id` in role bindings.
- `source` (String) `local`, `scim` or `oidc`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import shoal_group.payments_devs grp_01hx...
```
